item.title: HTB-Conversor Writeup
item.description: 本文章以 kali 地址为 10.10.16.35 做演示 初始侦察 nmap 端口扫描 ┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Work/Kali] └─$ sudo nmap --min-rate 10000 -p- 10.129.187.74 Starting Nmap 7.95 ( https://nmap.org ) at 2026-01-22 08:17 EST Nmap scan report for 10.129.187.74 Host is up (0.079s latency). Not shown: 65533 closed tcp ports (reset) PORT STATE SERVICE 22/tcp open ssh 80/tcp open http Nmap done: 1 IP address (1 host up) scanned in 9.24 seconds 开放了两个 TCP 端口 22 和 80。
